pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE BIRTH AND CHILDHOOD OF JESUS CHRIST

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Early Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 4.3: The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do Christians celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the dedication of baby Jesus

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the dedication of baby Jesus
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the dedication of baby Jesus. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ in the examples.
2. Explain The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.
4. Show that you can: describe the dedication of baby Jesus

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Luke 1:26-38 and Luke 2:1- 20 in turns,
2. Collaboratively, make a presentation on the annunciation of the Birth of Jesus Christ using PowerPoint slides or charts,
3. Read Luke 2:22-38 in turns and make short notes,
4. In groups discuss the importance of the dedication of baby Jesus,
5. Read Luke 2:41-52 and retell the story of Jesus Christ in the Temple,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the dedication of baby Jesus

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
